card.fires_on: The piece "ethyl" completing desmethyl or desethyl in names of drug metabolites, such as O-desmethylvenlafaxine. It also fires weakly on "post" before marketing or partum.

modes.label: Desmethyl metabolite names
modes.description: "ethyl" ending the "desm-ethyl" or "des-ethyl" stem just before the parent drug name.

modes.label: Post before a hyphen or noun
modes.description: "post" starting words like post-marketing or post-partum.

card.writes: It pushes toward word starts like gr, fl, qu and k, which suggests the start of the parent drug name that follows.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a metabolite name like desmethyl-venlafaxine where the parent drug name comes next.
